message.content:
On guidance management now expects fourth fiscal quarter 2026 revenue to be in the range of 1930000000 to 1950000000 with a mid-point representing year-over-year growth of approximately 37% [D1], which represents an improvement from the previous release that expected third fiscal quarter 2026 revenue in the range of 1730000000 to 1750000000 with a mid-point representing year-over-year growth of approximately 29% [D2].

What is working includes record Q3 results and outlook reflecting the growing relevance of strategy and portfolio enabling customers to solve complex engineering challenges across end markets [D1], strong momentum in commercial communications showing 56 percent growth [D1], solid performance in aerospace defense and government with 14 percent growth [D1], and double-digit growth across all end markets for the electronic industrial solutions group including automotive energy general electronics and semiconductor [D2].

What is not working includes no specific negative items named by management in the newest release [D1].
